reason: Both methods compare the same logical components of a Calendar (year and day-of-year versus year, month, and day-of-month). For any non-null Calendar instances, a matching year and day-of-year implies a matching month and day-of-month, and vice versa. Both methods throw a NullPointerException when either argument is null, so there is no input that causes differing behavior. Therefore no concrete separating test case exists.
